question:
If p + q implies p - q, p - q implies p × q, p × q implies p ÷ q and p ÷ q implies p + q, then find the value of

5 + 6 - 75 × 15 ÷ 30
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03f606139c736cc1af8c6f5c78ea44c324f88530185109c0f836e68c8ced7a54.png] 

Given: 5 + 6 - 75 × 15 ÷ 30

The logic follows here is:

By inserting codes and then using BODMAS Rule:

5 - 6 × 75 ÷ 15 + 30

= 5 - 6 × 5 + 30

= 5 - 30 + 30 

= 35 - 30

= 5

Hence, **5 **is the correct answer.
